[[File:Sublight_Drive_Station_D-639.png|thumb|Diagram of Sublight Drive Station D-639]]
'''Sublight Drive Station D-639''' was a location on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. It was a technical sector where the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] units, [[Radiation Vent|radiation vents]] and [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] were located. The station monitored power level, and could be accessed by [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].
